module.Title: Send a Foundry Status Message
module.Teaching: std::cout sends information to the console. The << operator pushes each value into the output stream, quotation marks create text, and \n moves the terminal to a new line.
module.PredictionQuestion: What does the << operator do with std::cout?
PredictionOptions: Sends a value into the output stream
module.PredictionExplanation: With std::cout, << inserts the value on its right into the console output stream.
module.DebugPrompt: Console output needs two less-than symbols and the statement must end with a semicolon.
module.RecallPrompt: Use the exact identifiers std and cout as std::cout. Print the exact text Foundry online\n.
module.TransferPrompt: Use the exact identifiers std and cout as std::cout. Print the exact text Cooling system ready\n.
module.PreviewMessage: The diagnostic message board can now report foundry status.
